subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'contributes'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"contributes"** means to give or add to a common purpose. ("योगदान देना").

 
 
• **Example:** Agriculture contributes significantly to India's GDP.
 
 
 
• The term **"contributes"** is used here to denote the role of agriculture in adding value to the Gross Domestic Product (GDP), which is a measure of economic performance.

Therefore, the correct answer is - **contributes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Assume"** involves taking something for granted without proof. ("मान लेना").
 
• **"Insist"** means to demand something forcefully, not accepting refusal. ("जोर देना")
 
• **"Insight" **means an understanding of something. ("अंतर्दृष्टि")
